annotations.title: Work out a tarot birth card

description:
Reduces a birth date to its tarot birth card by this site's own rule, with 11, 22 and 33 held as master numbers, returning the card, its Roman numeral and every step of the arithmetic. Use it for a birth, life or destiny card. Date alone decides it.

DELEGATE THIS RATHER THAN DERIVING IT: sum the year's digits, add day and month, reduce the same way, BUT THE REDUCTION HALTS ON 11, 22 AND 33, read through roots 2, 4 and 6. 1993 sums to 22 and stops; reducing on to 4 gives another card. Root 8 is Strength in the Rider-Waite-Smith numbering used here, Justice in Marseille packs.

A twentieth-century convention found in no early tarot source. https://totallytarot.net/library/policy/method

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "1994-06-05" (reduces to 7, The Chariot). Time and place change nothing.
